title: Connect the launcher to the v0.1 server
acceptance:
**Story or goal** · Enable the built client to reach the selected local installation.

**Expected behaviour** · Accept an explicit loopback server address. Check status and version, forward API calls and open the browser.

**Scope boundary** · The operator starts and stops the backend independently.

**Previous in delivery queue** · WI-025

**Depends on** · WI-025

**Verify** · Exercise ready, unreachable and incompatible servers. Stop the client and verify the same server still responds.

**Effort basis** · Windows process lifecycle and integration across the host boundary.
evidence: Host tests cover ready, unreachable (502 `Server unreachable`) and incompatible servers (expected 0.1, found reported) and the v0.1 server stayed up when the client stopped (separate process). Launch lines observed: `Server ready: version 0.1 schema 2 at http://127.0.0.1:49674` and `FoundationOS 0.2 client ready at http://127.0.0.1:55296/`. The separate v0.1 server on 49674 continued answering after the client host was stopped and restarted on 61686. Owner accepted PI-02 on 27 November 2026.
